Havoc immerses players in the aftermath of The Silence, a world where factions fight for survival and territory.

This is a hardcore extraction shooter built around real risk and consequence. It is loud, punishing, and unforgiving. Headphones are strongly recommended to hear threats early, as success depends entirely on your skill.

Havoc is currently available as paid access. Purchasing grants immediate access to the current build and all future updates.

>> The game runs on seasonal wipes. Gear, stash, and progress reset each season, but your profile and cosmetics are permanent.

Keybinds can be viewed in the Settings menu but cannot be changed at the moment.

>> The game is available on Console and PC. Controllers are not supported; mouse and keyboard are required.

games.name: Undead Defense
games.desc:
Undead Defense is a teamwork based zombie survival game where players are divided into two teams: humans and zombies.
The goal is simple: humans must survive until the end of the 6 waves, while zombies try to infect all the humans.

As a Human: 👤
Find a safe spot, build barricades, cooperate, fight off zombies, and upgrade

As a Zombie: 🧟
Attack humans, coordinate with other zombies, and don’t give up: Even if you die, you’ll respawn and keep attacking until all humans are infected or until the wave has ended.

[PC Controls] 💻
E - Grab prop
RMB (Right mouse button) - Use zombie ability / Nail prop
Q - Zombie type selection menu / Rotate prop
T - Tilt prop
B - Shop
O - Cosmetic Shop
I - Cosmetic Inventory
F - Flashlight
Z - Emotes
CTRL - Crouch

[Console Controls] 🎮
X - Grab prop / Use zombie ability / Nail prop 
Up on DPad - Flashlight
Down on DPad - Emotes
L2 - Tilt Prop
R2 - Rotate prop

Tags: Zombie Survival, Multiplayer, Half-Life, Valve, Garry's Mod, FPS, First Person Shooter
